matrix_name.name: epoxy resin
matrix_name.description: EP matrix impregnated into the Al2O3 platelet-isolated MXene porous microsphere skeleton and then cured.

fillers.name: Ti3C2Tx MXene
fillers.description: MXene nanosheets assembled into porous microspheres using an NH4HCO3 salt template under vortex flow; KH792 ethanol diluent was used during microsphere preparation.

fillers.name: aluminum oxide
fillers.description: Al2O3 platelets (Al2O3p) with shell-like arrangement around the MXene porous microspheres; platelet radial dimension about 33.7 μm.
